title: Ayakashi Triangle
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Matsuri Kazamaki, a teenage ninja exorcist, protects his childhood friend Suzu Kanade, a spirit medium who attracts ayakashi spirits. When a cat-like ayakashi king, Shirogane, casts a forbidden spell that turns Matsuri into a girl, he must keep fighting spirits and attend school in a female body while his feelings for Suzu grow.
life_message: Loyalty and love can hold steady even when your body and circumstances change beyond your control.
